notes.title: Working hard to improve Brave Ball's graphics
notes.content:
Pedro from Pidroh Games here! Hope everyone is doing fine!

Lately I have decided to improve the art direction for the scenario and made some experiments. You can see the 3 current ideas for areas we have in the gif below.

[img]https://pidroh.github.io/website/assets/gameplay_scenariochange.gif[/img]

We think the new balance of light, darkness and contrast makes the game easier to play.

[img]https://pidroh.github.io/website/assets/SavedScreen202109240825214403.png[/img][img]https://pidroh.github.io/website/assets/gameplayt.gif[/img][img]https://pidroh.github.io/website/assets/lightmockupb.png[/img][img]https://pidroh.github.io/website/assets/SavedScreen202109240828267823.png[/img]Do let us know if you have any thoughts on the direction we are going!
